icon-inverse-neutral.description: Leading icon of an inverse snackbar with the neutral intent. White, like the text, because a neutral message has no status to signal.

icon-inverse-info.description: Leading status icon of an inverse snackbar with the info intent. On the dark bar this icon is the only place the intent shows, so always pair it with a glyph that differs per intent, never colour alone.

icon-inverse-success.description: Leading status icon of an inverse snackbar with the success intent. On the dark bar this icon is the only place the intent shows, so always pair it with a glyph that differs per intent, never colour alone.

icon-inverse-caution.description: Leading status icon of an inverse snackbar with the caution intent. On the dark bar this icon is the only place the intent shows, so always pair it with a glyph that differs per intent, never colour alone.

icon-inverse-warning.description: Leading status icon of an inverse snackbar with the warning intent. On the dark bar this icon is the only place the intent shows, so always pair it with a glyph that differs per intent, never colour alone.

icon-tinted-neutral.description: Leading icon of a tinted snackbar with the neutral intent.

icon-tinted-info.description: Leading status icon of a tinted snackbar with the info intent, matching the tint and the border.

icon-tinted-success.description: Leading status icon of a tinted snackbar with the success intent, matching the tint and the border.

icon-tinted-caution.description: Leading status icon of a tinted snackbar with the caution intent, matching the tint and the border.

icon-tinted-warning.description: Leading status icon of a tinted snackbar with the warning intent, matching the tint and the border.

bg-control-inverse-default.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on an inverse snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. The same as the bar, so the action reads as text until it is hovered or pressed.

bg-control-inverse-hover.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on an inverse snackbar, on hover. The same for every intent.

bg-control-inverse-pressed.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on an inverse snackbar, while pressed. The same for every intent.

bg-control-tinted-neutral-default.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted neutral snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. The same as the snackbar fill, so the action reads as text until it is hovered or pressed.

bg-control-tinted-neutral-hover.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted neutral snackbar, on hover: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-neutral-pressed.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted neutral snackbar, while pressed: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-info-default.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted info snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. The same as the snackbar fill, so the action reads as text until it is hovered or pressed.

bg-control-tinted-info-hover.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted info snackbar, on hover: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-info-pressed.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted info snackbar, while pressed: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-success-default.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted success snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. The same as the snackbar fill, so the action reads as text until it is hovered or pressed.

bg-control-tinted-success-hover.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted success snackbar, on hover: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-success-pressed.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted success snackbar, while pressed: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-caution-default.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted caution snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. The same as the snackbar fill, so the action reads as text until it is hovered or pressed.

bg-control-tinted-caution-hover.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted caution snackbar, on hover: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-caution-pressed.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted caution snackbar, while pressed: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-warning-default.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted warning snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. The same as the snackbar fill, so the action reads as text until it is hovered or pressed.

bg-control-tinted-warning-hover.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted warning snackbar, on hover: one step darker than the tint.

bg-control-tinted-warning-pressed.description: Fill of the action and close buttons on a tinted warning snackbar, while pressed: one step darker than the tint.

label-control-inverse-default.description: Action label on an inverse snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. A light brand blue, so the action stands apart from the white message on every intent; the fill, not the label, shows hover and press.

label-control-inverse-hover.description: Action label on an inverse snackbar, on hover. A light brand blue, so the action stands apart from the white message on every intent; the fill, not the label, shows hover and press.

label-control-inverse-pressed.description: Action label on an inverse snackbar, while pressed. A light brand blue, so the action stands apart from the white message on every intent; the fill, not the label, shows hover and press.

label-control-tinted-neutral-default.description: Action label on a tinted neutral snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Brand coloured, since a neutral message has no intent colour to follow.

label-control-tinted-neutral-hover.description: Action label on a tinted neutral snackbar, on hover. Brand coloured, since a neutral message has no intent colour to follow; darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-neutral-pressed.description: Action label on a tinted neutral snackbar, while pressed. Brand coloured, since a neutral message has no intent colour to follow; darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-info-default.description: Action label on a tinted info snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Follows the intent colour.

label-control-tinted-info-hover.description: Action label on a tinted info snackbar, on hover. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-info-pressed.description: Action label on a tinted info snackbar, while pressed. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-success-default.description: Action label on a tinted success snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Follows the intent colour.

label-control-tinted-success-hover.description: Action label on a tinted success snackbar, on hover. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-success-pressed.description: Action label on a tinted success snackbar, while pressed. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-caution-default.description: Action label on a tinted caution snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Follows the intent colour.

label-control-tinted-caution-hover.description: Action label on a tinted caution snackbar, on hover. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-caution-pressed.description: Action label on a tinted caution snackbar, while pressed. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-warning-default.description: Action label on a tinted warning snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Follows the intent colour.

label-control-tinted-warning-hover.description: Action label on a tinted warning snackbar, on hover. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

label-control-tinted-warning-pressed.description: Action label on a tinted warning snackbar, while pressed. Follows the intent colour and darkens with the fill so it keeps AA contrast.

icon-control-inverse-default.description: Close icon on an inverse snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Dimmer than the message so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-inverse-hover.description: Close icon on an inverse snackbar, on hover. Dimmer than the message so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-inverse-pressed.description: Close icon on an inverse snackbar, while pressed. Dimmer than the message so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-neutral-default.description: Close icon on a tinted neutral snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-neutral-hover.description: Close icon on a tinted neutral snackbar, on hover. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-neutral-pressed.description: Close icon on a tinted neutral snackbar, while pressed. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-info-default.description: Close icon on a tinted info snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-info-hover.description: Close icon on a tinted info snackbar, on hover. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-info-pressed.description: Close icon on a tinted info snackbar, while pressed. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-success-default.description: Close icon on a tinted success snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-success-hover.description: Close icon on a tinted success snackbar, on hover. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-success-pressed.description: Close icon on a tinted success snackbar, while pressed. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-caution-default.description: Close icon on a tinted caution snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-caution-hover.description: Close icon on a tinted caution snackbar, on hover. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-caution-pressed.description: Close icon on a tinted caution snackbar, while pressed. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-warning-default.description: Close icon on a tinted warning snackbar, at rest and on keyboard focus. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-warning-hover.description: Close icon on a tinted warning snackbar, on hover. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

icon-control-tinted-warning-pressed.description: Close icon on a tinted warning snackbar, while pressed. Neutral grey on every tint so dismissing stays secondary to the action.

focus-ring.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring around the action and close buttons, on both appearances. Apply on focus-visible only. The snackbar container itself never takes focus.

min-height.description: Minimum height of the snackbar, reached by a single line of message. Two lines, a title or the stacked layout grow it past this.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside the snackbar before the leading icon or text, and after the text when there is no action or close button.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding above and below the content in the inline layout, and top and bottom padding of the stacked layout, where the close button sits this far from the top. With the 32px action button this lands exactly on min-height, and the snackbar grows from there when the message wraps.

padding-end-control.description: Right padding of the snackbar in both layouts, where the action or close button meets the edge. With content-padding-end it keeps the text 16px from the edge when no control is shown.

gap.description: Horizontal gap between the leading icon and the text in both layouts.

gap-text.description: Vertical gap between the title and the message. Zero, so the two read as one block and the 22px line heights alone space them. For the gap between the text and the controls use gap-controls.

gap-controls.description: Gap before each visible control: between the text block and the first control, and between the action and close buttons in the inline layout; between the text block and the close button in the stacked layout. Hidden controls leave no gap, so the text fills the row.

content-padding-end.description: End padding of the icon and text block in both layouts. Adds to gap-controls for 12px between the text and the first control, and to padding-end-control for 16px from the edge when no control sits beside the text.

content-padding-top-stacked.description: Top padding of the icon and text block in the stacked layout. Adds to padding-y so the text starts 12px from the top while the close button sits 8px from the top and right, optically centred in the corner.

stacked-gap.description: Vertical gap between the text block and the action row in the stacked layout, used when the action label is too long to sit inline.

icon-size.description: Size of the leading status icon, one step larger than the 20px text line so the status reads at a glance. Centred on the text block in the inline layout.

radius.description: Corner radius of the snackbar container on both appearances.

border-width.description: Stroke width of the tinted snackbar outline. The inverse appearance has no border.

control-height.description: Visible height of the action and close buttons. Expand the hit area to min-touch-target in code.

control-padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside the action button around its label.

control-radius.description: Corner radius of the action and close button fills on hover and press.

close-size.description: Width and height of the square close button. Expand the hit area to min-touch-target in code.

close-icon-size.description: Size of the close glyph inside the close button.

min-touch-target.description: Minimum tappable size of the action and close buttons, independent of their visible size. Expand the hit area in code rather than growing control-height.

focus-ring-width.description: Stroke width of the focus ring around the action and close buttons.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focused button and its focus ring.

focus-ring-radius.description: Corner radius of the focus ring, one step rounder than control-radius so the ring stays concentric with the button across the offset.

margin-mobile.description: Distance from the snackbar to the screen edges on mobile, measured from the safe area and above any bottom navigation.

margin-desktop.description: Distance from the snackbar to the viewport edge on web and tablet layouts.

bg-strong-neutral.description: Solid fill of a strong neutral badge, used for counts and tags that carry no status, such as a result count or Sold out. Count badges default to strong; for a calmer tag use bg-subtle-neutral.

bg-strong-brand.description: Solid fill of a strong brand badge, used for promotional tags such as New, Deal or MMT Exclusive. Count badges default to strong; for a calmer tag use bg-subtle-brand.

bg-strong-info.description: Solid fill of a strong info badge, used for informational tags and counts such as Updated or Beta. Count badges default to strong; for a calmer tag use bg-subtle-info.

bg-strong-success.description: Solid fill of a strong success badge, used for positive status such as Free cancellation or Confirmed. Count badges default to strong; for a calmer tag use bg-subtle-success.

bg-strong-caution.description: Solid fill of a strong caution badge, used for advisory status such as Few seats left or Price rising. Count badges default to strong; for a calmer tag use bg-subtle-caution.

bg-strong-warning.description: Solid fill of a strong warning badge, used for unread notification counts and error status such as Payment failed. Count badges default to strong; for a calmer tag use bg-subtle-warning.

label-strong-neutral.description: Count or text colour on a strong neutral badge. Paired with bg-strong-neutral and holds AA contrast on it.

label-strong-brand.description: Count or text colour on a strong brand badge. Paired with bg-strong-brand and holds AA contrast on it.

label-strong-info.description: Count or text colour on a strong info badge. Paired with bg-strong-info and holds AA contrast on it.

label-strong-success.description: Count or text colour on a strong success badge. Paired with bg-strong-success and holds AA contrast on it.

label-strong-caution.description: Count or text colour on a strong caution badge. Paired with bg-strong-caution and holds AA contrast on it.

label-strong-warning.description: Count or text colour on a strong warning badge. Paired with bg-strong-warning and holds AA contrast on it.

bg-subtle-neutral.description: Tinted fill of a subtle neutral badge, the calm option for status tags beside content. Not used for dots, which are strong only. On the grey bg-secondary canvas the fill edge disappears and the text alone carries the badge.

bg-subtle-brand.description: Tinted fill of a subtle brand badge, the calm option for status tags beside content. Not used for dots, which are strong only.

bg-subtle-info.description: Tinted fill of a subtle info badge, the calm option for status tags beside content. Not used for dots, which are strong only.

bg-subtle-success.description: Tinted fill of a subtle success badge, the calm option for status tags beside content. Not used for dots, which are strong only.

bg-subtle-caution.description: Tinted fill of a subtle caution badge, the calm option for status tags beside content. Not used for dots, which are strong only.

bg-subtle-warning.description: Tinted fill of a subtle warning badge, the calm option for status tags beside content. Not used for dots, which are strong only.

label-subtle-neutral.description: Count or text colour on a subtle neutral badge. Paired with bg-subtle-neutral and holds AA contrast on it.

label-subtle-brand.description: Count or text colour on a subtle brand badge. Paired with bg-subtle-brand and holds AA contrast on it.

label-subtle-info.description: Count or text colour on a subtle info badge. Paired with bg-subtle-info and holds AA contrast on it.

label-subtle-success.description: Count or text colour on a subtle success badge. Paired with bg-subtle-success and holds AA contrast on it.

label-subtle-caution.description: Count or text colour on a subtle caution badge. Paired with bg-subtle-caution and holds AA contrast on it.

label-subtle-warning.description: Count or text colour on a subtle warning badge. Paired with bg-subtle-warning and holds AA contrast on it.

dot-neutral.description: Fill of a neutral dot badge, a count-free marker for new or unread content. The same colour as bg-strong-neutral, kept separate so it is checked for 3 to 1 contrast against both page canvases.

dot-brand.description: Fill of a brand dot badge, a count-free marker for new or unread content. The same colour as bg-strong-brand, kept separate so it is checked for 3 to 1 contrast against both page canvases.

dot-info.description: Fill of an info dot badge, a count-free marker for new or unread content. The same colour as bg-strong-info, kept separate so it is checked for 3 to 1 contrast against both page canvases.

dot-success.description: Fill of a success dot badge, a count-free marker for new or unread content. The same colour as bg-strong-success, kept separate so it is checked for 3 to 1 contrast against both page canvases.

dot-caution.description: Fill of a caution dot badge, a count-free marker for new or unread content. The same colour as bg-strong-caution, kept separate so it is checked for 3 to 1 contrast against both page canvases.

dot-warning.description: Fill of a warning dot badge, a count-free marker for new or unread content. The same colour as bg-strong-warning, kept separate so it is checked for 3 to 1 contrast against both page canvases.

height-sm.description: Height of a small count or text badge. Small badges sit in tabs, on icons and in dense rows; use height-md beside larger text.

height-md.description: Height of a medium count or text badge, used on cards and beside headings. Use height-sm in tabs and on icons.

min-width-sm.description: Minimum width of a small count or text badge. Equal to height-sm so a one-digit count renders as a circle.

min-width-md.description: Minimum width of a medium count or text badge. Equal to height-md so a one-digit count renders as a circle.

padding-x-count.description: Left and right padding inside a count badge at both sizes. Kept tight so a one-digit count stays a circle and 99+ stays compact; text badges use padding-x-text-sm or padding-x-text-md.

padding-x-text-sm.description: Left and right padding inside a small text badge. For count badges use padding-x-count.

padding-x-text-md.description: Left and right padding inside a medium text badge, roomier than the small size so a tag beside a card title does not look cramped. For count badges use padding-x-count.

padding-bottom-sm.description: Bottom padding inside a small count or text badge, with no top padding. Lato capitals sit low in the 16 px line box, so this lifts the label by 1 px and centres it optically. Medium badges need no offset.

dot-size-sm.description: Width and height of a small dot badge, used in tabs and on icons.

dot-size-md.description: Width and height of a medium dot badge, used beside larger text such as a card title.

radius.description: Corner radius of count and dot badges, a full pill so they read as notifications. Text badges use radius-text instead.

radius-text.description: Corner radius of text badges, a small rounding so a tag such as New reads as a label rather than a notification count. Count and dot badges use radius.

bg-unselected-default.description: Fill of an unselected tab at rest and on keyboard focus. Transparent, so the tab bar or page shows through; the label carries the tab.

bg-unselected-hover.description: Fill of an unselected tab on hover, a neutral state layer. Selected tabs hover to the same grey through bg-selected-hover.

bg-unselected-pressed.description: Fill of an unselected tab while pressed. One step darker than hover, because bg-fill-pressed-subtle is the same grey as hover and would show no change.

bg-selected-default.description: Fill of the selected tab at rest and on keyboard focus. Transparent: the brand label and the indicator mark the selection, not a fill.

bg-selected-hover.description: Fill of the selected tab on hover, the same neutral state layer as an unselected tab.

bg-selected-pressed.description: Fill of the selected tab while pressed. The label darkens to label-selected-pressed so it keeps AA contrast on this grey.

bg-disabled.description: Fill of a disabled tab, selected or not. Transparent, with no hover or pressed layer.

label-unselected-default.description: Label colour of an unselected tab at rest and on keyboard focus. Quieter than the selected brand label so the active tab stands out.

label-unselected-hover.description: Label colour of an unselected tab on hover, darkening to invite the tap.

label-unselected-pressed.description: Label colour of an unselected tab while pressed.

label-selected-default.description: Label colour of the selected tab at rest and on keyboard focus. Pairs with the brand indicator.

label-selected-hover.description: Label colour of the selected tab on hover. Stays text-brand, which holds AA on the hover grey.

label-selected-pressed.description: Label colour of the selected tab while pressed. One step darker than text-brand, which falls below AA on the pressed grey.

label-disabled.description: Label colour of a disabled tab, selected or not.

icon-unselected-default.description: Colour of the icon above the label on an unselected Primary tab, at rest and on keyboard focus. Matches label-unselected-default.

icon-unselected-hover.description: Colour of the icon on an unselected Primary tab on hover, darkening with the label.

icon-unselected-pressed.description: Colour of the icon on an unselected Primary tab while pressed.

icon-selected-default.description: Colour of the icon on the selected Primary tab, at rest and on keyboard focus. Matches label-selected-default.

icon-selected-hover.description: Colour of the icon on the selected Primary tab on hover.

icon-selected-pressed.description: Colour of the icon on the selected Primary tab while pressed, darkening with the label on the pressed grey.

icon-disabled.description: Colour of the icon on a disabled Primary tab, selected or not.

indicator-default.description: Colour of the underline under the selected tab in every enabled state. Only the selected tab draws it.

indicator-disabled.description: Colour of the underline under a selected tab that is disabled.

track.description: Colour of the full-width line under a row of Primary or Secondary tabs, drawn by the tab list rather than by each tab so it runs past the last tab. The selected indicator sits on top of it.

focus-ring.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring drawn inside the tab edge.

primary-min-height.description: Minimum height of a Primary tab with its icon above the label. Also its touch target.

primary-padding-x.description: Left and right padding inside a Primary tab. The indicator is inset by the same amount.

primary-padding-y.description: Top and bottom padding inside a Primary tab.

primary-gap.description: Vertical gap between the icon and the label row in a Primary tab.

primary-icon-size.description: Width and height of the icon above the label in a Primary tab.

primary-badge-offset-x.description: Distance from the left edge of the Primary tab icon to the left edge of its badge. The badge is pinned to the top right of the icon and grows to the right, so 99+ never covers the glyph more than a single digit does.

primary-badge-offset-y.description: How far the top of the Primary tab badge rises above the top of the icon. A count overhangs the icon corner and a dot straddles it.

secondary-min-height.description: Minimum height of a Secondary tab. Also its touch target.

secondary-padding-x.description: Left and right padding inside a Secondary tab. The indicator is inset by the same amount.

secondary-padding-y.description: Top and bottom padding inside a Secondary tab. The min height sets the final height.

secondary-gap-badge.description: Horizontal gap between the label and its badge in a Secondary tab. Primary tabs pin the badge to the icon instead, with primary-badge-offset-x and primary-badge-offset-y.

radius.description: Corner radius of the hover and pressed fill of a tab.

indicator-height.description: Thickness of the underline under the selected tab.

indicator-radius.description: Corner radius of the underline, rounding its ends.

track-width.description: Thickness of the line under a row of Primary or Secondary tabs, drawn by the tab list.

focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

focus-ring-inset.description: Gap between the top, left and right edges of the tab and its focus ring. The ring is drawn inside so neighbouring tabs and a scrolling row never clip it, and it runs down to the bottom edge, where it merges with the selected indicator.

focus-ring-radius.description: Corner radius of the focus ring on both tab types, the same 8 px as the tab fill radius. Inset 2 px at the top and sides, the top corners read slightly rounder than a concentric 6 px curve, which the radius scale does not have.

bg-grouped.description: Background of the white card that holds a grouped list on the grey bg-secondary page. A plain list has no background of its own and shows the white bg page through its rows.

item-bg-default.description: Fill of a list row at rest. Transparent, so the row shows the list background behind it.

item-bg-hover.description: Fill of an interactive list row on hover, a neutral state layer. Rows with a trailing button are static and never take it.

item-bg-pressed.description: Fill of an interactive list row while pressed. Stronger than item-bg-hover so the press reads on touch screens without a hover step.

item-bg-disabled.description: Fill of a disabled list row. Transparent; the dimmed text and icons carry the disabled state.

title-default.description: Colour of the title, the first and main line of a list row. Use supporting-text-default for the lines below it.

title-disabled.description: Colour of the title of a disabled list row.

supporting-text-default.description: Colour of the second and third lines of a list row, which add detail under the title. Use meta-text-default for the short value at the end of the row.

supporting-text-disabled.description: Colour of the supporting lines of a disabled list row.

meta-text-default.description: Colour of the short trailing value of a list row, such as a price, a time or an airport code. Use supporting-text-default for lines under the title.

meta-text-disabled.description: Colour of the trailing value of a disabled list row.

leading-icon-default.description: Colour of a bare leading icon in a list row. For an icon inside a tinted circle use the leading-container-icon tokens.

leading-icon-disabled.description: Colour of a bare leading icon in a disabled list row.

leading-container-bg-neutral.description: Fill of the neutral grey circle behind a leading icon, for everyday menu rows. Use leading-container-bg-brand to call out one row.

leading-container-bg-brand.description: Fill of the light blue circle behind a leading icon, for a row that should stand out from its neutral neighbours. Use sparingly, at most one kind per list.

leading-container-bg-disabled.description: Fill of the circle behind a leading icon in a disabled list row, whichever tint it has when enabled.

leading-container-icon-neutral.description: Colour of the icon inside a neutral leading circle. Pairs with leading-container-bg-neutral.

leading-container-icon-brand.description: Colour of the icon inside a brand leading circle. Pairs with leading-container-bg-brand.

leading-container-icon-disabled.description: Colour of the icon inside a leading circle in a disabled list row.

chevron-default.description: Colour of the trailing chevron that marks a list row as a link to another screen. Quieter than leading icons so the row content leads.

chevron-disabled.description: Colour of the trailing chevron of a disabled list row.

divider.description: Colour of the hairline between list rows. It starts where the row text starts and is left off the last row. Use grouped-gap spacing, not a divider, between groups.

section-header-text.description: Colour of the section header label that names a group of rows, such as Recent searches. Use title-default for the rows themselves.

focus-ring.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring drawn inside the edge of a focused list row.

min-height-comfortable.description: Minimum height of a one-line Comfortable row, also its touch target. Taller rows grow with their content. Comfortable is the default and the only density for touch screens.

min-height-compact.description: Minimum height of a one-line Compact row. Compact is for pointer-first web lists only; use min-height-comfortable on touch screens.

padding-x-comfortable.description: Space between the row edge and its content, left and right, in a Comfortable row.

padding-x-compact.description: Space between the row edge and its content, left and right, in a Compact row. Kept equal to Comfortable so densities align in one layout.

padding-y-comfortable.description: Space above and below the content of a Comfortable row.

padding-y-compact.description: Space above and below the content of a Compact row.

gap-comfortable.description: Space between the leading slot and the text of a Comfortable row. Use gap-text-trailing-comfortable before the trailing slot and gap-trailing-comfortable inside it.

gap-compact.description: Space between the leading slot and the text of a Compact row. Use gap-text-trailing-compact before the trailing slot and gap-trailing-compact inside it.

gap-text-trailing-comfortable.description: Space between the text and the trailing slot of a Comfortable row. Wider than gap-comfortable so a meta value or chevron reads apart from the title. Use gap-comfortable between the leading slot and the text.

gap-text-trailing-compact.description: Space between the text and the trailing slot of a Compact row. Wider than gap-compact so a meta value or chevron reads apart from the title. Use gap-compact between the leading slot and the text.

gap-trailing-comfortable.description: Space between items inside the trailing slot of a Comfortable row, such as a meta value and its chevron.

gap-trailing-compact.description: Space between items inside the trailing slot of a Compact row, such as a meta value and its chevron.

gap-text.description: Space between the title, the supporting text and the third line of a row. Zero, so the lines read as one block and their line heights alone space them. Use gap-text-trailing-comfortable or gap-text-trailing-compact between the text and the trailing slot.

leading-icon-size-comfortable.description: Size of a bare leading icon in a Comfortable row. Icons inside a circle use leading-container-icon-size-comfortable.

leading-icon-size-compact.description: Size of a bare leading icon in a Compact row.

leading-container-size-comfortable.description: Diameter of the tinted circle behind a leading icon in a Comfortable row.

leading-container-size-compact.description: Diameter of the tinted circle behind a leading icon in a Compact row.

leading-container-icon-size-comfortable.description: Size of the icon inside a leading circle in a Comfortable row.

leading-container-icon-size-compact.description: Size of the icon inside a leading circle in a Compact row.

leading-image-size-comfortable.description: Width and height of a leading avatar or thumbnail in a Comfortable row. Matches the leading circle so mixed rows align.

leading-image-size-compact.description: Width and height of a leading avatar or thumbnail in a Compact row.

chevron-size-comfortable.description: Size of the trailing chevron in a Comfortable row.

chevron-size-compact.description: Size of the trailing chevron in a Compact row.

section-header-padding-top-comfortable.description: Space above a section header label in a Comfortable list. Its left and right padding follow padding-x-comfortable.

section-header-padding-top-compact.description: Space above a section header label in a Compact list.

section-header-padding-bottom-comfortabl.description: Space between a section header label and the first row below it, in a Comfortable list.

section-header-padding-bottom-compact.description: Space between a section header label and the first row below it, in a Compact list.

leading-container-radius.description: Corner radius of the tinted circle behind a leading icon. Always a full circle.

image-radius.description: Corner radius of a leading avatar, a full circle. Use image-radius-square for hotel or airline thumbnails.

image-radius-square.description: Corner radius of a square leading thumbnail, such as a hotel photo or an airline logo. Use image-radius for people.

grouped-radius.description: Corner radius of the card that holds a grouped list. The first and last rows clip their hover and pressed fills to it.

grouped-gap.description: Space between two grouped cards, or between a card and the next section header.

divider-width.description: Thickness of the hairline between list rows.

focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring of a list row.

focus-ring-inset.description: Distance from the row edge in to the focus ring. The ring sits inside because rows run edge to edge and a neighbour would cover an outside ring.

focus-ring-radius.description: Corner radius of the keyboard focus ring of a list row.

track-on-default.description: Track of a switch that is on, at rest. Also used by the Outlined backup style. Use track-on-disabled when the switch is disabled.

track-on-hover.description: Track of a switch that is on, under the pointer. Web only.

track-on-pressed.description: Track of a switch that is on, while held.

track-on-disabled.description: Track of a disabled switch that is on. The same lightest grey as the disabled off track, so a disabled switch reads as disabled first and the thumb position shows its value.

track-off-default.description: Solid grey track of a switch that is off, at rest. Below 3:1 against the canvas by choice, so the thumb position carries the value.

track-off-hover.description: Track of a switch that is off, under the pointer. Web only.

track-off-pressed.description: Track of a switch that is off, while held.

track-off-disabled.description: Track of a disabled switch that is off. The same grey as track-on-disabled and lighter than the enabled off track; the thumb position shows the value.

outlined-track-off-default.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. White track of a switch that is off, at rest, drawn with outlined-border-off-default around it.

outlined-track-off-hover.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Track of a switch that is off, under the pointer. Web only.

outlined-track-off-pressed.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Track of a switch that is off, while held.

outlined-track-off-disabled.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Track of a disabled switch that is off.

outlined-border-off-default.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Outline of the off track. Meets 3:1 against both canvases. A switch that is on has no outline.

outlined-border-off-disabled.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Outline of the off track when the switch is disabled.

thumb-default.description: White thumb, on every track and in every state including disabled. The Outlined backup style uses it only when the switch is on.

outlined-thumb-off-default.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Grey thumb of a switch that is off, at rest.

outlined-thumb-off-hover.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Thumb of a switch that is off, under the pointer. Web only.

outlined-thumb-off-pressed.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Thumb of a switch that is off, while held.

outlined-thumb-off-disabled.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Thumb of a disabled switch that is off. Lighter than outlined-thumb-off-default so it never reads as enabled.

icon-on-default.description: Check glyph inside the white thumb of a switch that is on, at rest and on focus. Tracks track-on-default so glyph and track read as one colour.

icon-on-hover.description: Check glyph of a switch that is on, under the pointer. Tracks track-on-hover. Web only.

icon-on-pressed.description: Check glyph of a switch that is on, while held. Tracks track-on-pressed.

icon-on-disabled.description: Check glyph of a disabled switch that is on.

icon-off-default.description: Close glyph inside the white thumb of a switch that is off, at rest and on focus. Darker than the off track so it keeps 3:1 on the white thumb.

icon-off-hover.description: Close glyph of a switch that is off, under the pointer. Steps darker with track-off-hover. Web only.

icon-off-pressed.description: Close glyph of a switch that is off, while held. Stays darker than track-off-pressed.

icon-off-disabled.description: Close glyph of a disabled switch that is off.

outlined-icon-on.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Check glyph inside the white thumb of a switch that is on, in every enabled state. Use outlined-icon-disabled when the switch is disabled.

outlined-icon-off.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Close glyph inside the grey thumb of a switch that is off.

outlined-icon-disabled.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Check glyph of a disabled switch that is on. When the switch is off, the glyph keeps outlined-icon-off, because the thumb there is grey.

focus-ring.description: Keyboard focus ring drawn around the track, outside it, with focus-ring-offset between the two.

track-width-sm.description: Track width of the Small switch. Small is for dense web layouts such as tables and filter panels; use Medium on touch.

track-width-md.description: Track width of the Medium switch, the default on mobile and web.

track-height-sm.description: Track height of the Small switch.

track-height-md.description: Track height of the Medium switch.

thumb-size-sm.description: Thumb diameter of the Small switch. In the Outlined style this is the on thumb, and the off thumb uses outlined-thumb-size-off-sm or outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-sm.

thumb-size-md.description: Thumb diameter of the Medium switch. In the Outlined style this is the on thumb, and the off thumb uses outlined-thumb-size-off-md or outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-md.

outlined-thumb-size-off-sm.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Smaller thumb of an off Small switch without a glyph. It keeps the centre of the full thumb, so it grows in place when switched on.

outlined-thumb-size-off-md.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Smaller thumb of an off Medium switch without a glyph. It keeps the centre of the full thumb, so it grows in place when switched on.

outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-sm.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Thumb of an off Small switch that shows the close glyph. Smaller than thumb-size-sm so it clears the outline; use outlined-thumb-size-off-sm when there is no glyph.

outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-md.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Thumb of an off Medium switch that shows the close glyph. Smaller than thumb-size-md so it clears the outline; use outlined-thumb-size-off-md when there is no glyph.

thumb-inset.description: Gap between the full-size thumb and the track edge at both sizes, on every side. The one exception is the start edge of an off Outlined switch, which uses outlined-thumb-inset-off-start.

outlined-thumb-inset-off-start.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Gap between the thumb slot and the start edge of the track when the switch is off. Smaller than thumb-inset so the off thumb sits flush with the start edge, which balances it optically against the on state.

icon-size-sm.description: Glyph size inside the Small thumb.

icon-size-md.description: Glyph size inside the Medium thumb.

radius.description: Corner radius of the track, the thumb and the focus ring. Always a full pill or circle.

outlined-border-width.description: Outlined backup style only, not for product use. Width of the off track outline, drawn inside the track so the switch does not change size.

focus-ring-width.description: Width of the keyboard focus ring.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between the track edge and the focus ring.

min-touch-target-sm.description: Minimum hit area of the Small switch on web, the WCAG 2.5.8 floor. Small is not for touch.

min-touch-target-md.description: Minimum hit area of the Medium switch. Pad the track to this size on touch platforms, or make the whole row tappable.

track.description: Grey track behind every segment, in both thumb styles. The thumb slides over it. For the fill of an unselected segment use bg-unselected-default, which lets this track show through.

bg-unselected-default.description: Fill of an unselected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. Transparent, so the track shows through. The selected segment is painted by the thumb instead.

bg-unselected-pressed.description: Fill of an unselected segment while pressed, including while a drag that started on it is held over it. A selected segment darkens its thumb instead, through neutral-thumb-pressed or brand-thumb-pressed.

label-unselected-default.description: Label of an unselected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. Quieter than the selected label so the thumb reads as the choice. For a disabled segment use label-disabled.

label-unselected-pressed.description: Label of an unselected segment while pressed, darkening with the pressed fill.

label-disabled.description: Label of a disabled segment, selected or not, in both thumb styles.

icon-unselected-default.description: Optional leading icon of an unselected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. Matches label-unselected-default.

icon-unselected-pressed.description: Optional leading icon of an unselected segment while pressed. Matches label-unselected-pressed.

icon-disabled.description: Optional leading icon of a disabled segment, selected or not, in both thumb styles.

thumb-disabled.description: Thumb under a selected segment that is disabled, in both thumb styles. Drawn without a shadow. For an enabled thumb use neutral-thumb-default or brand-thumb-default.

focus-ring.description: Keyboard focus ring drawn outside the focused segment, focus-ring-offset away from its edge, on the grey track. Shown for hardware keyboards, Android D-pad and iOS Full Keyboard Access, never on touch.

neutral-thumb-default.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. White thumb under the selected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. Lifted off the grey track by neutral-thumb-shadow, because the fill alone barely separates from the track.

neutral-thumb-pressed.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. White thumb while it is held, before a tap lands or while it is dragged. Keeps neutral-thumb-shadow.

neutral-thumb-shadow.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. Elevation of the white thumb in every enabled state. Carries most of the separation from the track. A disabled thumb drops it.

neutral-label-selected-default.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. Brand label of the selected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. For the pressed thumb use neutral-label-selected-pressed, because this colour falls below AA on the pressed grey. For a disabled segment use label-disabled.

neutral-label-selected-pressed.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. Brand label of the selected segment while the thumb is held. One step darker than neutral-label-selected-default so it keeps AA on the pressed grey.

neutral-icon-selected-default.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. Optional leading icon of the selected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. Matches neutral-label-selected-default.

neutral-icon-selected-pressed.description: Neutral thumb style, under test against the Brand thumb. Optional leading icon of the selected segment while the thumb is held. Matches neutral-label-selected-pressed.

brand-thumb-default.description: Brand thumb style, under test against the Neutral thumb. Solid brand thumb under the selected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. Drawn without a shadow.

brand-thumb-pressed.description: Brand thumb style, under test against the Neutral thumb. Solid brand thumb while it is held, before a tap lands or while it is dragged.

brand-label-selected-default.description: Brand thumb style, under test against the Neutral thumb. Label on the brand thumb in every enabled state, including pressed. During a drag a label switches to this colour only once the thumb centre enters its segment, so it never sits on the grey track.

brand-icon-selected-default.description: Brand thumb style, under test against the Neutral thumb. Optional leading icon on the brand thumb at rest and on keyboard focus. For the pressed thumb use brand-icon-selected-pressed.

brand-icon-selected-pressed.description: Brand thumb style, under test against the Neutral thumb. Optional leading icon on the brand thumb while it is held, on the pressed brand fill. The same role as the default step, kept as its own token so every state binds its own icon, as in Button.

tinted-thumb-default.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Brand-tinted thumb under the selected segment at rest and on keyboard focus. The tint barely separates from the track, so tinted-thumb-border-default draws its edge.

tinted-thumb-pressed.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Brand-tinted thumb while it is held, before a tap lands or while it is dragged.

tinted-thumb-border-default.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Outline of the tinted thumb at rest and on keyboard focus. Drawn inside the thumb so it does not change size, and it carries the selection against the track.

tinted-thumb-border-pressed.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Outline of the tinted thumb while it is held.

tinted-label-selected-default.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Label on the tinted thumb at rest and on keyboard focus. For the pressed thumb use tinted-label-selected-pressed, because this colour falls below AA on the pressed tint.

tinted-label-selected-pressed.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Label on the tinted thumb while it is held. One step darker than tinted-label-selected-default so it keeps AA on the pressed tint.

tinted-icon-selected-default.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Optional leading icon on the tinted thumb at rest and on keyboard focus. Matches tinted-label-selected-default.

tinted-icon-selected-pressed.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Optional leading icon on the tinted thumb while it is held. Matches tinted-label-selected-pressed.

height-md.description: Height of the Medium track, for form-level choices such as trip type. Segments fill it minus track-padding. The hit area grows to min-touch-target.

height-sm.description: Height of the Small track, for compact filters inside cards. Segments fill it minus track-padding. The hit area grows to min-touch-target.

track-padding.description: Gap between the track edge and the thumb on every side, at both sizes. Also the difference between the track radius and the thumb radius, which keeps the corners concentric.

track-radius-md.description: Corner radius of the Medium track and of the focus ring around a Medium segment. Equals thumb-radius-md plus track-padding.

track-radius-sm.description: Corner radius of the Small track and of the focus ring around a Small segment. Equals thumb-radius-sm plus track-padding.

thumb-radius-md.description: Corner radius of the Medium thumb and the pressed fill of a Medium segment. The focus ring uses track-radius-md.

thumb-radius-sm.description: Corner radius of the Small thumb and the pressed fill of a Small segment. The focus ring uses track-radius-sm.

pill-radius.description: Pill shape, under test against the rounded corners of track-radius-md and track-radius-sm. Corner radius of the track, the thumb, the pressed fill and the focus ring at both sizes, so every edge is a full semicircle.

segment-padding-x-md.description: Minimum left and right padding inside a Medium segment. Segments share the track width equally, and a label that does not fit truncates.

segment-padding-x-sm.description: Minimum left and right padding inside a Small segment. Segments share the track width equally, and a label that does not fit truncates.

gap-icon.description: Horizontal gap between the optional leading icon and the label, at both sizes.

icon-size.description: Width and height of the optional leading icon, at both sizes.

min-touch-target.description: Minimum hit area height of every segment at both sizes. Extend the tappable area above and below the track to this height rather than drawing a taller track.

focus-ring-width.description: Width of the keyboard focus ring on a segment.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between the focused segment and its focus ring. With focus-ring-width it fills track-padding exactly, so the ring sits on the track and stays visible around either thumb.

tinted-thumb-border-width.description: Tinted thumb style, under test against the Neutral and Brand thumbs. Width of the outline of the tinted thumb, drawn inside it.

bg.description: Fill of the menu panel, white on either canvas. The panel always carries a border and the overlay shadow, so it still separates from a white page. Rows inside take item-bg-* fills, never this one.

border.description: Hairline around the menu panel, so it reads as a separate layer on a white page where the shadow alone is faint. Use divider for the lines between groups inside the menu.

border-width.description: Width of the hairline around the menu panel. Use divider-width for the lines between groups.

radius-comfortable.description: Corner radius of the Comfortable menu panel. Rows inside use item-radius-comfortable, which is smaller so the row highlight nests inside the panel corner. Compact panels use radius-compact.

radius-compact.description: Corner radius of the Compact menu panel. Rows inside use item-radius-compact, which is smaller so the row highlight nests inside the panel corner. Comfortable panels use radius-comfortable.

padding-comfortable.description: Space between the Comfortable menu panel edge and its rows, on all four sides, so the rounded row highlight sits inset from the panel edge.

padding-compact.description: Space between the Compact menu panel edge and its rows, on all four sides. Compact is for pointer-first web menus only.

offset.description: Gap between the trigger and the menu panel when it opens, and between a parent row and its submenu.

min-width.description: Narrowest a menu panel gets, so a menu of short labels still reads as a list. The panel hugs its widest row between min-width and max-width.

max-width.description: Widest a menu panel gets. Longer labels wrap to a second line rather than widening the panel; if many labels wrap, the content wants a dialog or a sheet, not a menu.

item-bg-default.description: Fill of a menu row at rest, so the panel shows through. Use item-bg-hover and item-bg-pressed for interaction.

item-bg-hover.description: Fill of a neutral menu row under the pointer, a neutral state layer. Destructive rows use item-bg-destructive-hover. Touch screens never show it.

item-bg-pressed.description: Fill of a neutral menu row while it is pressed or tapped. Destructive rows use item-bg-destructive-pressed.

item-bg-focus.description: Fill of a neutral menu row that holds keyboard focus. Arrow keys move this highlight, and focus-ring draws on top of it because the fill alone is too faint to find. Destructive rows use item-bg-destructive-hover.

item-bg-open.description: Fill of a row whose submenu is open, so the user can see which row the submenu belongs to. Only rows with a chevron take it.

item-bg-disabled.description: Fill of a disabled menu row, the same as rest. A disabled row never takes a hover or pressed fill.

item-bg-destructive-hover.description: Fill of a destructive menu row, such as Delete or Cancel booking, under the pointer or keyboard focus. A red tint warns before the click. Neutral rows use item-bg-hover.

item-bg-destructive-pressed.description: Fill of a destructive menu row while it is pressed or tapped. Neutral rows use item-bg-pressed.

item-radius-comfortable.description: Corner radius of a Comfortable row highlight and of its focus ring. The panel uses radius-comfortable, which is larger so the row nests inside it.

item-radius-compact.description: Corner radius of a Compact row highlight and of its focus ring. The panel uses radius-compact, which is larger so the row nests inside it.

label-default.description: Label of a neutral menu row at rest and in every interactive state, and of a selected row, where the check carries selection. Destructive rows use label-destructive-default.

label-disabled.description: Label of a disabled menu row, neutral or destructive. Disabled rows stay in the menu so the user learns the action exists.

label-destructive-default.description: Label of a destructive menu row, such as Delete or Cancel booking, at rest. Use label-destructive-hover under the pointer or keyboard focus, and label-destructive-pressed while pressed.

label-destructive-hover.description: Label of a destructive menu row on the item-bg-destructive-hover tint, under the pointer or keyboard focus. It is a step darker so it keeps contrast.

label-destructive-pressed.description: Label of a destructive menu row on the item-bg-destructive-pressed tint, a step darker again so it keeps contrast.

supporting-text-default.description: Second line under a menu label, a short explanation of the action. Use meta-text-default for a value or shortcut at the end of the row.

supporting-text-disabled.description: Second line of a disabled menu row.

meta-text-default.description: Trailing text at the end of a menu row: a keyboard shortcut on web, or a current value or count. Use supporting-text-default for a second line under the label.

meta-text-disabled.description: Trailing text of a disabled menu row.

leading-icon-default.description: Leading icon of a neutral menu row in every interactive state. Destructive rows use leading-icon-destructive-default.

leading-icon-disabled.description: Leading icon of a disabled menu row, neutral or destructive.

leading-icon-destructive-default.description: Leading icon of a destructive menu row at rest. Use leading-icon-destructive-hover under the pointer or keyboard focus, and leading-icon-destructive-pressed while pressed.

leading-icon-destructive-hover.description: Leading icon of a destructive menu row on the item-bg-destructive-hover tint, under the pointer or keyboard focus.

leading-icon-destructive-pressed.description: Leading icon of a destructive menu row on the item-bg-destructive-pressed tint.

chevron-default.description: Trailing chevron that marks a row as opening a submenu. It is quieter than the leading icon because it signals structure, not the action.

chevron-disabled.description: Trailing chevron of a disabled submenu row.

check-default.description: Trailing check on the selected row of a single-select menu, such as Sort by. It is the only mark of selection, so the label stays label-default.

check-disabled.description: Trailing check on a selected row that is disabled.

section-header-text.description: Small header that names a group of menu rows. It is not interactive and never takes a fill.

divider.description: Hairline between groups of menu rows, and above the destructive row. Use border for the outline of the panel.

divider-width.description: Width of the hairline between groups of menu rows.

focus-ring.description: Ring drawn inside the edge of the menu row that holds keyboard focus, on top of item-bg-focus. It follows item-radius-comfortable or item-radius-compact.

focus-ring-width.description: Width of the keyboard focus ring on a menu row.

item-min-height-comfortable.description: Minimum height of a one-line Comfortable menu row, also its touch target. Comfortable is the default and the only density for touch screens.

item-min-height-compact.description: Minimum height of a one-line Compact menu row. Compact is for pointer-first web menus only, never touch screens.

item-padding-x-comfortable.description: Space between the start and end of a Comfortable row highlight and its content.

item-padding-x-compact.description: Space between the start and end of a Compact row highlight and its content.

item-padding-y-comfortable.description: Space above and below the content of a Comfortable menu row. With a one-line label it makes the row exactly item-min-height-comfortable.

item-padding-y-compact.description: Space above and below the content of a Compact menu row. With a one-line label it makes the row exactly item-min-height-compact.

gap-comfortable.description: Space between the leading icon and the label in a Comfortable row. Use gap-text-trailing-comfortable before the trailing slot.

gap-compact.description: Space between the leading icon and the label in a Compact row. Use gap-text-trailing-compact before the trailing slot.

gap-text-trailing-comfortable.description: Minimum space between the text and the trailing meta, chevron or check in a Comfortable row.

gap-text-trailing-compact.description: Minimum space between the text and the trailing meta, chevron or check in a Compact row.

gap-text.description: Space between the label and the supporting text line. Use gap-text-trailing-comfortable or gap-text-trailing-compact before the trailing slot.

leading-icon-size-comfortable.description: Size of the leading icon in a Comfortable menu row. Use trailing-icon-size-comfortable for the chevron and check.

leading-icon-size-compact.description: Size of the leading icon in a Compact menu row. Use trailing-icon-size-compact for the chevron and check.

trailing-icon-size-comfortable.description: Size of the trailing chevron or check in a Comfortable menu row.

trailing-icon-size-compact.description: Size of the trailing chevron or check in a Compact menu row.

section-header-padding-top-comfortable.description: Space above a Comfortable section header, inside the group it names. Its sides use item-padding-x-comfortable so it lines up with the labels.

section-header-padding-top-compact.description: Space above a Compact section header. Its sides use item-padding-x-compact so it lines up with the labels.

section-header-padding-bottom-comfortabl.description: Space between a Comfortable section header and the first row it names.

section-header-padding-bottom-compact.description: Space between a Compact section header and the first row it names.

divider-spacing-comfortable.description: Space above and below a divider in a Comfortable menu, so groups read as separate without a section header.

divider-spacing-compact.description: Space above and below a divider in a Compact menu.
